description: Start a transactional batch of edits. While a changeset is open, every edit tool stages its result in memory: nothing is written to disk until commit_changeset, and all reads (get_map, get_record, list_plugins, ...) reflect the staged edits. Commit writes every staged file in one step (all or nothing) and can be rolled back later with undo_changeset; discard_changeset drops the staged edits. Only one changeset can be open at a time; restore_backup is refused while one is open and set_project discards it. Playtests read from disk, so they only see committed edits. The RPG Maker editor must stay closed while the server edits the project.

label.description: Short description of the batch, e.g. 'Add the blacksmith to Town'
